description: 災害防救演習成果總結報告 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 行政院. 中央各災害防救業務主管機關結合全國22個縣（市）於防汛期前動員全國縣市辦理演習，並配合國防部萬安演習同步實施，以驗證中央及地方政府整體災害防救機制運作能力. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 行政院. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml, csv, json. The portal shows 2026-06-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
